verdict.rationale: NetHunt documents moving real-time customer data to other systems via webhooks, which gives outbound change propagation. A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec, so an API exists for the inbound direction, but its contents are unverified. missing for 10: documented rate limits, upsert semantics, explicit change-detection mechanics (e.g. modified-since queries or change feeds), evidence of bidirectional sync at scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection

citations.quote: Move real-time customer data from one system to another using webhooks.
